body_markdown:
Join Redwire in RAI Amsterdam from May 26-28 to get a closer look at Redwire’s European satellite platforms — Hammerhead and Phantom — plus our ELSA solar array, designed to deliver high power at low cost. Visit us at booth #670 to discover how our platforms and avionics are supporting the most exciting ESA missions like PROBA-3, Hera, ALTIUS, and Skimsat.


**Speaking Engagements**


Thursday, May 28, 3 p.m.
Panel:The Market for Orbital Environmental Services and Active Debris Removal
Juan Pablo Ramos, Redwire Business Development Manager
